title: Coral and the Verdict
author: Ulyana Nakamura
blurb: Sebastian Ravensworth, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
